name: Haskell
description: Code intelligence for Haskell projects using the language server installed with GHCup.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in Haskell files. Install haskell-language-server with GHCup and make haskell-language-server-wrapper available on PATH. This plugin uses the Haskell language server and GHC installed for your project. The server starts when you open a Haskell file in a project and stops when none are open.
failed: The Haskell language server could not start.
missing: Install haskell-language-server with GHCup and make haskell-language-server-wrapper available on PATH.
